第1章 您的天赋太差，系统等的花儿都谢了！-《天赋太差全凭系统黑化》
林雲躺在床上，听着脑子里系统的传来的提示音，翻来覆去，久久的不能入睡。
“您的阴阳五行功等的花儿都谢了……由于您的天赋太差，已经形成黑化，练功速度急剧膨胀，已提高三千倍！”
尤其林雲是穿越而来，醒来之时发现自己竟然成了这昊日城中龙行镖局总镖头林天朔之子。
谁知道自己的武学天赋极差，自己从六岁便开始练功习武，学习阴阳五行功，却没有丝毫的长进！
林雲现如今都已经十八岁了，居然，连个三阶武者都不是！连同镖局的六岁小儿都不如！
不过让林雲意想不到的是，在他穿越来到新世界后，竟然意外的开启了一个神秘的系统。
林雲随手便开启了系统的控制面板，所有的属性和指标也很普普通通，没有任何一项突出的。
他所练习的阴阳五行功，已经形成黑化，练功的进度提高道了惊天动地的三千倍！！！
林雲此时的心里面犯着嘀咕，三千倍的练功速度，这听上去都感觉已经逆天了，这不不科学啊。
content_en:
Chapter 1 Your talent is so poor that all the flowers in the system have withered! - "The talent is too poor and it all depends on the system's blackening"
Chapter 1 Your talent is so poor that all the flowers in the system have withered! - "The talent is too poor and it all depends on the system's blackening"
Lin Yun lay on the bed, listening to the system notifications in his head, tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep for a long time.
"The flowers of your Yin Yang and Five Elements Kung Fu have all withered... Because your talent is so poor, it has turned black and your practice speed has increased dramatically, increasing three thousand times!"
Especially Lin Yun came through time travel, and when he woke up, he found that he was the son of Lin Tianshuo, the chief escort of Longxing Escort Bureau in Haori City.
Who knew that his martial arts talent was extremely poor? He had been practicing martial arts since he was six years old, learning Yin Yang and Five Elements Kung Fu, but he had not made any progress at all!
Lin Yun is now eighteen years old. Unexpectedly, he is not even a third-level warrior! Not even as good as the six-year-old child in the escort agency!
But what Lin Yun didn't expect was that after he traveled to the new world, he unexpectedly opened a mysterious system.
Lin Yun casually opened the system's control panel. All the attributes and indicators were ordinary, and none of them stood out.
The yin-yang and five-element skills he practiced have become black, and the progress of his training has increased by an earth-shattering three thousand times! ! !
Lin Yun was muttering in his heart at this time, practicing at a speed of three thousand times, this sounds like it is already against the heavens, this is not unscientific.
